name: whack-a-mlaude
description: Claude Code plugin for looking ultra-focused while Claude does the hard work. While Claude is working, a whack-a-mole game appears above your prompt. It looks like agent output and uses your session's real prompts, tool calls and replies. Now and then a character slowly turns into a little mole. Hover over it to whack it. Unofficial, not affiliated with Anthropic.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Show the game while a turn is running.

height.title: Height (rows)
height.description: Rows the game area takes above the prompt, score row included.

speed.title: Speed
speed.description: Overall game speed multiplier: 2 = moles come twice as often and hide twice as fast.

maxMoles.title: Moles at once
maxMoles.description: Most moles that can be out at the same time.

spawnMinMs.title: Spawn interval min (ms)
spawnMinMs.description: Shortest wait before the next mole appears (at speed 1).

spawnMaxMs.title: Spawn interval max (ms)
spawnMaxMs.description: Longest wait before the next mole appears (at speed 1).

lifetimeMs.title: Mole lifetime (ms)
lifetimeMs.description: How long a mole takes to grow, hold and shrink back (at speed 1).

spawnMinRow.title: Spawn area: first row
spawnMinRow.description: Moles only appear from this row down (0 = top row of the game area).

spawnMaxRow.title: Spawn area: last row
spawnMaxRow.description: Moles only appear down to this row; -1 = the bottom row of the text area.

ramp.title: Ramp difficulty
ramp.description: Game speeds up as your score grows.

hover.title: Hover to whack
hover.description: On: moving the pointer over a mole whacks it. Off: click it.

marker.title: Pointer marker
marker.description: Softly highlight the character under the pointer and flash a spark when you hit a mole. Off = no cursor is drawn at all.

showScore.title: Show score
showScore.description: Show the score and missed counter on the bottom row of the game area.

keepScore.title: Keep score between prompts
keepScore.description: Carry your score over from one prompt to the next instead of starting at 0 each time.

rememberScore.title: Remember score between sessions
rememberScore.description: Also save the score when a session ends and load it in the next one.

summary.title: End-of-round summary
summary.description: Show a congratulations summary when Claude finishes. Lines come from hooks/messages.ts.

compactSummary.title: Compact summary
compactSummary.description: Make the end-of-round summary small and quiet: just 'N whacked | N missed' for 3 seconds, without the joke line.

pauseSpamCount.title: Pause-spam limit
pauseSpamCount.description: Pausing this many times within the window earns a cheeky comment.

pauseSpamWindowSec.title: Pause-spam window (s)
pauseSpamWindowSec.description: How many seconds the pause-spam count covers.

scrollMs.title: Scroll speed (ms)
scrollMs.description: Roughly how often the real session text scrolls by one line.

flashMs.title: Start flash (ms)
flashMs.description: Length of a short flash shown before the game appears (0 = no flash, the default).
